newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden to maintain budget discipline - Asbrink.
newsitem.headline: Sweden to maintain budget discipline - Asbrink.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Friday the government would maintain strict budget discipline and that he was leaning towards tighter fiscal policy.
"I am completely convinced that we will still have very strict budgetary discipline in Sweden," Asbrink told reporters.
The strict budget discipline will include resources which can be used for special areas, Asbrink said.
"The sectors we will prioritise are employment, as well as health care, care for the elderly, child care, education and environmental issues in order to have a sustainable country," Asbrink said.
